description.text: This course could be a 5-year master-doctorate degree program. The fee of Teaching Material Pre-pay the deposit CNY 3000.Collect the fees according to the price of that time.

duration.text: The Etio-biology at Hebei Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4027 USD/per year ￥ 29000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker.

requirements.text: There is no requirement on HSK for applying the course taught in English.All courses can be taught in English.
